title: The estimator of the seven hand-picked LCFs, as trained weights
description: A net1 that estimates expliCCit's seven hand-picked LCFs as distributions over 64 bins (three members, averaged). compact uses it three ways: its input scaler scales the measurements every controller reads, the fixed rule on it (a window of 2^0.25 times its believed bandwidth-delay product) is the reference each closed-loop evaluation is paired with and the first teacher of a new controller, and it is the estimator of the hand-picked baseline. Copied from the project compact was forked from, so that compact's experiments read it from compact's own releases (source: release exp-net1v6-149 of Radonux/palaestra, file net1-v6-s0/net1.pt, kept unchanged as estimator/source-net1.pt). The source saves its settings in an earlier flat form that compact's code does not read, so experiments/estimator_convert.py rewrites the settings into the current form, leaves the weights and scalers untouched, and checks that the result loads: estimator/net1.pt. estimator/SOURCE_PARTS lists the source's parts; summary.md gives what was loaded and each file's size and SHA-256.
run: mkdir -p "$OUT/estimator" /tmp/src && curl -fsSL --retry 5 --retry-all-errors https://api.github.com/repos/Radonux/palaestra/releases/tags/exp-net1v6-149 > /tmp/source.json && jq -r '[.assets[] | select(.name | contains(".tar.zst.part-"))] | sort_by(.name) | .[] | "\(.name) \(.size) \(.browser_download_url)"' /tmp/source.json > "$OUT/estimator/SOURCE_PARTS" && test -s "$OUT/estimator/SOURCE_PARTS" && cut -d' ' -f3 "$OUT/estimator/SOURCE_PARTS" | while read -r u; do curl -fsSL --retry 5 "$u"; done | zstd -dcq | tar -x -C /tmp/src --wildcards '*net1-v6-s0/net1.pt' && F=$(find /tmp/src -path '*net1-v6-s0/net1.pt' | head -1) && test -s "$F" && cp "$F" "$OUT/estimator/source-net1.pt" && uv run python experiments/estimator_convert.py "$OUT/estimator/source-net1.pt" "$OUT/estimator/net1.pt" > "$OUT/estimator/LOADED.md"
collect: { cat "$OUT/estimator/LOADED.md"; echo; echo '| file | bytes | sha256 |'; echo '|---|---|---|'; for f in "$OUT"/estimator/*.pt; do echo "| estimator/$(basename "$f") | $(stat -c %s "$f") | $(sha256sum "$f" | cut -d' ' -f1) |"; done; } > "$OUT/summary.md"
